0.1.1.en: Initial dev release for Homey Pro mini: Tessie token auth, Tesla pairing, climate/charging/lock/frunk/trunk controls, 60s polling, and repair flow.

0.1.2.en: Fix Configure/settings page so token save works. Refresh logo assets with cleaner branding and proper Homey image dimensions.

0.1.3.en: Fix pairing crash when Tessie vehicles response is wrapped in an object; use official Tesla logos for app and vehicle images.

0.1.4.en: Add device control buttons, trunk close safety, thermostat display, vehicle status conditions, and GPS geofence triggers.

0.1.5.en: Add lock, trunk, window, and charge port toggle controls; add detailed door, window, trunk, frunk, port, and lock conditions.
